title: Empat Puluh Persen
subject: a Medan radio weather forecaster who every morning is phoned by listeners asking which forty percent of the city will get the rain, until he starts answering street by street
caption: Melayu Deli joget, lively northern Sumatran Malay dance style. Accordion playing a bouncing melody with grace-note turns, two violins doubling in octaves, gendang ronggeng hand drum keeping the joget pulse, tambourine on the offbeat, plucked acoustic bass. Live room recording, warm tape, dry percussion. Male vocal, mid register, bright and cheerful, sung clearly in Indonesian. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, G major. Playful, bouncing mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no pop synths, no rap, no distorted guitar, no dangdut koplo drum pattern.
lyrics:
[Intro - accordion and gendang ronggeng]

[Verse 1]
Jam enam pagi aku siaran di radio
Telepon berbunyi, Bang, hari ini gimana
Aku bilang hujan empat puluh persen
Ibu di ujung sana tanya, persen yang mana

[Pre-Chorus]
Jemuran Ibu di Jalan Sei Kera
Jemuran Ibu di Jalan Sei Kera

[Chorus]
Empat puluh persen, tolong jangan salah paham
Bukan separuh kota, bukan sepanjang jalan
Empat puluh persen, bawa payung kalau ragu
Aku cuma baca awan, bukan baca hatimu

[Verse 2]
Tukang becak menelepon tanya soal Medan Johor
Di peta radar awannya malas gerak
Kujawab satu-satu, jalan demi jalan
Sei Kera kering dulu, Johor nanti sore

[Chorus]
Empat puluh persen, tolong jangan salah paham
Bukan separuh kota, bukan sepanjang jalan
Empat puluh persen, bawa payung kalau ragu
Aku cuma baca awan, bukan baca hatimu

[Verse 3]
Besok ada telepon dari gadis di Kampung Baru
Katanya jemuran Ibu cuma alasan
Dia tanya apa aku sendiri bawa payung
Kujawab nanti sore, aku datang jemput

[Chorus]
Seratus persen, hari ini aku mau ketemu
Bukan separuh hati, bukan sepanjang jalan
Seratus persen, nggak usah bawa payung
Awan boleh lewat, kamu tetap kutunggu

[Outro - accordion and violin]
